name: proof-or-bluff-realdeal-cli
description: Headless Node CLI for the realDeal Compact contract. Drives every circuit end-to-end against a local Midnight stack (or pre-prod) using a seed-phrase wallet, so we can exercise the wiring without a browser. Shares the on-chain contract with the browser app at ../app/.
_versionNotes: v8 SDK matrix per example-counter v2.1.1 + midnight-local-dev-johns-copy. POST-MIGRATION (May 16 2026): replaced @midnight-ntwrk/wallet@5.0.0 with the wallet-sdk-* family (facade/shielded/unshielded/dust), bumped ledger to v8, added compact-js for the CompiledContract pattern. See realDeal/docs/SDK_MATRIX_FINDING_2026-05-16.md.
